notes: Standalone Google AI Mode API (own RapidAPI listing and OpenWeb Ninja subscription; OWN slug google-ai-mode). GET /ai-mode and POST /ai-mode (same params in a JSON body, no URL length limit; attachments as a JSON array). Single response per call, no pagination; use apis/google-ai-mode/scrape.js. Pass data.session_token back as session_token to continue a multi-turn conversation.
